name: glance
description: A quick piece of information that opens more context one click away — an account notice, a balance, a count of pending items. `Glance` wraps react-aria's `DialogTrigger` and shares a `tone` (`default`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `destructive`) with its parts. `GlanceTrigger` is the compact button: an icon plus `GlanceText` (a `GlanceLabel` caption over a `GlanceValue`), or icon-only with `size="icon"` and an `aria-label`; `GlanceIndicator` pins a dot or count to its corner. `GlanceContent` is a popover holding a dialog (focus moves in, Escape closes, focus returns), laid out with `GlanceHeader`, `GlanceMedia` (an `IconTile` in the tone), `GlanceTitle`, `GlanceDescription` and `GlanceFooter`; its children can be a function of `{ close }` to close it from an action. Tone tints the trigger like `Alert`, with no motion — urgency comes from tone and wording.
